notes: description is null for every site: the media lists do not contain descriptions.
suggestedHero is chosen by a simple rule (original downloadable, credited, >=1600px wide, landscape, largest) and needs human review of subject and alt text.
thumbUrl is UNESCO's 250px thumbnail; use fileUrl (document page) to download the original where downloadOriginal is true.
Only CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO images are treated as open. Nomination-file images are a cession of rights to UNESCO, not a public licence.
